(5) Brute-force checked guessed URLs /clearance, /clearance-sale, /outlet, /home-clearance - all 404. (6) sitemap-landingpages.xml on api-ssl.shoppersstop.com (separate host) returned HTTP 503 on two attempts - a host outage, not a bot block (www.shoppersstop.com returned 200 throughout) - could not cross-check against it, but (1)-(5) already converge on a clear, multi-signal absence specifically scoped to Home. Conclusion: no genuine Clearance-type merchandising PLP exists for HomeStop/Home; the only discount-adjacent pages found are generic temporary-offer labels layered on ordinary category pages, which the brief explicitly says NOT to classify as Clearance.
